title: Pork and pepper pan skewers
summary: Pork and pepper pan skewers is a mexican dinner built around pork fillet and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat pork fillet dry and season it. Prep red peppers and red onions for Pork and pepper pan skewers so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook pork fillet on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook red peppers and red onions in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Pork and pepper pan skewers before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
